dedupe_keys.name: eurostat housing price statistics house price index house sales owner occupied housing price index

description: Eurostat's housing price statistics section covers the house price index, which measures changes in transaction prices of new and existing residential properties bought by households; house sales, covering changes in the number and value of housing transactions; and the owner-occupied housing price index, which tracks prices of dwellings bought for own use and the costs households bear as owner-occupiers. It also presents commercial real estate indicators, a prices dashboard and the Housing in Europe interactive publication; July 2026 news reported house prices up 4.7% in the euro area and rising house prices and rents in the first quarter of 2026. Coverage: EU member states and other reporting countries. Access: Eurostat database tables and dashboards linked from the section pages. Licence: Eurostat reuse policy; free. Caveats: indices show price changes, not price levels, and national methods differ. Simulation uses are adjusting building replacement and property values over time in loss and investment models. Related records: HM Land Registry Price Paid Data.
